parameters.description:
`msg-to-sendgrid-email` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your SendGrid email destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own SendGrid email destinations — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional SendGrid email destinations bound per enrollment.

In your SendGrid dashboard, authenticate the domain you plan to send from under Settings → Sender Authentication, then create an API key with 'Mail Send' permission under Settings → API Keys — that's your SENDGRID_EMAIL_APIKEY. Set SENDGRID_FROM to an address on that verified domain, and SENDGRID_TO to the recipient's address. UnitySVC sends each message as an email through SendGrid's API from the first address to the second.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment SendGrid destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to SendGrid v3 mail/send
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own SendGrid email destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

api_key.description: This enrollment's SendGrid Email apikey. Paste it or pick one of your secrets; it is kept as a secret and not shown again.

from.description: This enrollment's SENDGRID_FROM value (same format as SENDGRID_FROM). Paste it or pick one of your secrets; it is kept as a secret and not shown again.

to.description: This enrollment's SENDGRID_TO value (same format as SENDGRID_TO). Paste it or pick one of your secrets; it is kept as a secret and not shown again.
